name: wall-push-up
instructions:
1. Assume a standing position against a wall. Take a few steps away from the wall and lean in with your body at a 45 degree angle.
2. Keep the elbows locked out and ensure your body is in a straight line from head to heels.
3. Inhale and brace your core. Slowly descend by retracting the shoulder blades and unlocking the elbows.
4. Descend until the upper arms are parallel or your chest touches the wall.
5. Push back to the starting point by extending the elbows and driving your palms into the wall.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
